note: Of 19,953 contracts that were trading under Rs 2 in the last 7 sessions before expiry: 18.1% ever doubled, 5.8% reached 5x, 2.8% reached 10x, and 66.7% ended at a quarter of that price or less.

cautions.peak_not_exit: 'Reached 2x' means the premium touched 2x at some close. Selling at the peak is not something a person reliably does.
cautions.worthless_is_common: The share ending at a quarter or less is the number to read beside the multipliers, not after them.
cautions.charges_excluded: Brokerage, STT, exchange charges and GST are not included. On a Rs 2 premium they are a large share of the stake.
cautions.survivorship: Only contracts that existed and traded are counted. A strike nobody traded is invisible here.
